answer: Bond 500 POA per identity. Release after 3 unrelated confirmations. Rotate the auditor pool every 2 epochs so the same 3 signers cannot be reused. A kernel of 5 real operators cannot cover that, the thread of a farm shows as the same signers returning, and it cannot build 1,000 havens of unrelated vouchers out of 5 people.
